name: Youtube Video Strategy
description: Produces a YouTube video strategy document with title formulas, thumbnail concept specification, description template with timestamps, and tag list for a specific video topic. Use when the user asks to optimize a YouTube video for discovery, plan a YouTube upload, create a thumbnail concept, or write a video description. Do NOT use for writing the actual video script (use video-script-writing), creating a shot list (use video-storyboard), or planning short-form vertical video (use short-form-video-planning).
